description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) performance of Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) with different expansion strategies as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and is a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0. The plot includes four lines representing different DPR strategies: DPR without query (black line with no markers), DPR with corpus expansion (red line with circle markers), DPR with document expansion (green line with triangle markers), and DPR with asymmetric expansion (blue line with star markers). The DPR without query line remains relatively flat, starting just above 34.5 and ending just below 34.5. The DPR with corpus expansion line shows a steady increase, starting at approximately 35.0 and ending just below 35.5. The DPR with document expansion line fluctuates slightly but generally trends downward, starting at around 35.5 and ending just above 34.5. The DPR with asymmetric expansion line shows a slight decline, starting at around 35.0 and ending just above 34.5.
